setup.title: Spotify app missing
setup.intro: The Spotify app's credentials are part of the installation and are not entered here.
setup.step1: Create an app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard (APIs: Web API and Web Playback SDK) and add this redirect URI:
setup.step2: Put the client ID as SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and the secret into .env (locally), or store the secret in Parameter Store with pnpm run secret:put (AWS).
setup.step3: Restart or redeploy – details in the README.
